ViewObject.Name: MaxOrgLevel
ViewObject.SQLQuery: SELECT MAX(levels) AS organization_max_depth FROM ( SELECT o1.org_code, CASE WHEN o10.org_code IS NOT NULL THEN 10 WHEN o9.org_code IS NOT NULL THEN 9 WHEN o8.org_code IS NOT NULL THEN 8 WHEN o7.org_code IS NOT NULL THEN 7 WHEN o6.org_code IS NOT NULL THEN 6 WHEN o5.org_code IS NOT NULL THEN 5 WHEN o4.org_code IS NOT NULL THEN 4 WHEN o3.org_code IS NOT NULL THEN 3 WHEN o2.org_code IS NOT NULL THEN 2 WHEN o1.prnt_org_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS levels FROM ORGANIZATIONS o1 LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONS o2 ON o1.prnt_org_code = o2.org_code LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONS o3 ON o2.prnt_org_code = o3.org_code LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONS o4 ON o3.prnt_org_code = o4.org_code LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONS o5 ON o4.prnt_org_code = o5.org_code LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONS o6 ON o5.prnt_org_code = o6.org_code LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONS o7 ON o6.prnt_org_code = o7.org_code LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONS o8 ON o7.prnt_org_code = o8.org_code LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONS o9 ON o8.prnt_org_code = o9.org_code LEFT JOIN ORGANIZATIONS o10 ON o9.prnt_org_code = o10.org_code ) t
